amendmentReason: The connected Massive plan returned paginated partial hourly extracts and then rate-limit payloads before the development data freeze could complete. The fail-closed gate correctly prevented all E1 performance computation. To avoid selection-by-availability while preserving the already locked strategy rules, E1 development transport is now frozen to one full-series Yahoo Finance hourly source per instrument. Any E1 winner remains non-promotable until independent provider replication on Massive/Binance/contract-aware futures authority where applicable.

provider.developmentTransport: Yahoo Finance chart data through yfinance
provider.fullSeriesRule: Each instrument must be fetched as one internally consistent vendor series across warmup + development. Partial Massive files are audit evidence only and are excluded from E1 V3 outcomes.

preferredReplicationAuthorities.METALS_FUTURES_PROXY: Massive contract-specific futures after causal roll protocol
preferredReplicationAuthorities.INDEX: Massive index values plus mapping to an executable instrument before any fill claim

provider.failedInstrumentRule: Fail the entire V3 data freeze closed; no symbol substitution after outcomes.

timeframes.fourHourAggregation: UTC-anchored exact groups of four source bars; incomplete groups are discarded.
timeframes.smallTimeframeBoundary: 15m is excluded from E1 and remains a separate future transport/timeframe program.

semanticBoundaries.METALS_FUTURES_PROXY: GC=F and SI=F are vendor continuous/nearby development proxies. Their outcome cannot authorize production or a futures-market claim until contract-specific roll-aware replication passes.
semanticBoundaries.INDEX: ^NDX is an index value series and is not an executable fill instrument.
semanticBoundaries.FX: Vendor hourly series is development signal evidence; executable spread/slippage must be independently replicated.
semanticBoundaries.CRYPTO_SPOT: Venue-specific execution is not implied by Yahoo composite price history.
semanticBoundaries.EQUITY: Development bars use adjusted vendor history; earnings/event and NBBO execution layers remain separate.

opportunityAudit.purpose: Recall/false-negative audit only; never a model feature.

bootstrap.method: hierarchical instrument-timeframe bootstrap with circular candidate blocks

developmentDecisionRule.failureOutcome: No E1 threshold rescue. If no entry mode passes, S1/T1/M1 remain sealed and the candidate/setup architecture must be amended under a new prelock.

antiSelectionRules: No dropping losing instruments after outcomes.
No changing cost assumptions after gross results.
No using partial Massive extracts in V3 outcomes.
No treating ^NDX or vendor-continuous metals as executable fills.
nextAuthorizedAction: Freeze complete V3 hourly development files and SHA manifest without computing performance. Only a successful data-freeze commit may trigger the E1 V3 evaluator.
